subject.why: The rope bridge is instantly recognizable, complete with wooden planks, support posts, ropes, and the requested lantern detail.

category.why: The camera angle is looking down onto the bridge walkway from above rather than looking up from a low, heroic angle, and the floating sky islands violate the requirement for a simple grounding strip at the bottom.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, characters, or frames are present.

framing.why: The bridge spans the frame nicely with adequate breathing room in the sky above.

colour.why: Rich, saturated colors with warm wood tones, vibrant greens, and a clean blue sky gradient.

detail.why: No noisy micro-textures; forms are chunky, soft, and well-simplified.

style.why: Matches the reference style with smooth volumetric 3D shapes and a satin finish.

fix: Lower the camera angle to view the bridge heroically from below against the sky, and ground the scene with a clear horizontal strip of terrain at the bottom instead of floating islands.
